core_obligations: Read the bounds (proof lines 5721-5722): the situation supplies, for the objects of the covering family, an integer bound above which the cohomology of every member of the subcategory vanishes over a cofinal system of coverings.

Apply the companion criterion (proof lines 5722-5723): the companion result of this section, whose hypothesis is exactly of that shape, gives that the map from E to the derived limit of its truncations is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Extract the vanishing bounds from the situation.
Apply the companion criterion to conclude the isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in the situation of the Olsson-Laszlo comparison, every object of the derived category of the subcategory is recovered as the derived limit of its truncations (statement lines 5706-5719, whose annotation block recording the classical sources is a comment-type environment and is delivered as written; the situation fixing the hypotheses is delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5686-5704). The proof extracts the vanishing bounds supplied by the situation and applies the companion criterion of the same section (proof lines 5721-5723). The content is the matching of the bounds with the criterion. The claim is H2: one application of a companion criterion.
